#!/bin/bash
set -e

REPO="thedannywahl/pantoken"
PRS=(344 345 346)

echo "Monitoring PR checks..."
echo "━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━"

while true; do
  echo "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')"
  all_complete=true
  
  for pr in "${PRS[@]}"; do
    result=$(gh pr view $pr --repo "$REPO" --json statusCheckRollup -q '.statusCheckRollup | group_by(.conclusion) | map({conclusion: .[0].conclusion, count: length}) | @csv' 2>/dev/null || echo "")
    
    if [[ -z "$result" ]]; then
      echo "PR #$pr: status unavailable"
      all_complete=false
      continue
    fi
    
    # Count status
    pending=$(gh pr checks $pr --repo "$REPO" 2>/dev/null | grep "pending" | wc -l || echo "0")
    success=$(gh pr checks $pr --repo "$REPO" 2>/dev/null | grep "success" | wc -l || echo "0")
    failure=$(gh pr checks $pr --repo "$REPO" 2>/dev/null | grep "failure" | wc -l || echo "0")
    
    if [[ $pending -gt 0 ]]; then
      all_complete=false
      echo "PR #$pr: $success passed, $pending pending, $failure failed"
    else
      if [[ $failure -eq 0 ]]; then
        echo "PR #$pr: ✓ ALL CHECKS PASSED ($success)"
      else
        echo "PR #$pr: ✗ FAILED ($failure failures)"
      fi
    fi
  done
  
  if [[ "$all_complete" == "true" ]]; then
    echo "━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━"
    echo "All PR checks complete!"
    break
  fi
  
  echo "Waiting 10 seconds..."
  sleep 10
done
SCRIPT

chmod +x /tmp/monitor-prs.sh
timeout 600 /tmp/monitor-prs.sh || true
